text:
Elaine: FYI the mkdocs build for /guides/quickstart just errored on linkcheck — fragment to `#authenticating` not found in production build, but local preview works.
Tim: saw this before — often caused by inline code in headings creating weird slugs, e.g. `Using \`redwood.run()\``
DocsBot: linkcheck error: page=guides/quickstart.md, fragment=authenticating, status=404, run=CI#8421
Sam: can you paste the header line from the doc? quick guess: heading has backticks or emoji that changed the slug
Elaine: here's the top of the section:
```
### Authenticating with `redwood.run()`

Follow these steps to create an API key...
```
Tim: yep — mkdocs-material slugify strips/backticks differently than the previous renderer. Two quick fixes: 1) add an explicit header id, or 2) escape the inline code so the slug is stable.
Sam: example explicit id:
```
### Authenticating with `redwood.run()` {#authenticating}
```
Anna: or change heading to avoid backticks: `### Authenticating with redwood.run()` (no code fence), but that alters visual style.
Elaine: I'm ok with explicit id — less churn in content. I'll open a tiny PR.
DocsBot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4123 by @elaine — CI queued
Tim: add a quick unit in the docs checklist: "prefer explicit header ids for headings with inline code/emoji" — saves recurring flakiness.
Sam: also propose adding a linkcheck exemption for the deploy-preview step so authors can spot these earlier.
Anna: sg. Could we also enable the mkdocs plugin option to use english slugify rules? that might reduce surprises. Example config:
```
plugins:
  - search
  - mkdocs-awesome-anchors:
      slugify: python
```
Elaine: for now I'll land the PR that adds {#authenticating} and a short note in the contributor guide. I'll follow up with a config PR to try the plugin in staging.
Tim: thanks — once CI passes, can someone :eyes: and :shipit: the tiny change? low risk.
Sam: I'll review after build finishes.
DocsBot: CI passed for PR #4123 — all checks green.
Sam: LGTM. :thumbsup:
Elaine: merged and backported to main. Added TODO in docs/CONTRIBUTING.md about header-ids and a link to this thread.
Anna: nice, thanks all. Filing an infra follow-up to trial slugify change in staging (INFRA-1287).
Tim: closing this thread — if linkcheck resurfaces, we have the checklist and the quick-fix pattern. :white_check_mark:
